resolution.question: Loomis & Hale LLP signed a new client this morning. Will the two sides agree on a kickoff meeting time within 72 hours of the engagement letter being signed?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that both parties have agreed on a specific kickoff meeting time before 2026-10-09T09:30:00-07:00. Resolve NO if no such agreement is recorded by the cutoff.
